data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, not contingent on unanimity. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions; you may choose 18 even if others choose 10. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k, leaving 250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Each switch costs 8 now and 16 in the low-recovery outcome. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Long-run gains aren't assured.
